prompt:
I need a comprehensive financial model for a SaaS company. Create an Excel file called 'saas_model.xlsx' with these requirements:

1. Assumptions sheet with key metrics like customer acquisition cost ($150), monthly churn rate (2.5%), average revenue per user ($89/month), and annual growth rates
2. Revenue model with monthly recurring revenue projections for 3 years, showing new customers, churned customers, and net revenue
3. P&L statement with revenue, cost of goods sold (15% of revenue), sales & marketing (35% of revenue), R&D (25% of revenue), and G&A (12% of revenue)
4. Cash flow statement showing operating cash flow and free cash flow
5. Unit economics dashboard with metrics like LTV, LTV/CAC ratio, and payback period

Use proper Excel formulas throughout - no hardcoded values except for the base assumptions. Include professional formatting with the standard financial modeling color scheme (blue for inputs, black for formulas, etc.). The model should be dynamic so I can change assumptions and see updated results.
